# Umang Engineering

> Umang Engineering, the engineering division of Umang Global Group Pvt Ltd (Mumbai, India), designs, develops, and manufactures precision process equipment — extrusion, pelletization/spheronization, granulation, drying, coating, film processing, and continuous manufacturing systems — for the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food, chemical, personal care, and cosmetics industries. Operating for over 40 years, the company offers lab-scale to commercial-scale machinery, spare parts, contract manufacturing, and custom equipment development.

## Products

- [All Products](https://www.umangengineering.com/product): Overview of the process equipment portfolio
- [Extrusion Systems](https://www.umangengineering.com/products/extrusion-systems): Single/twin screw, hot-melt, basket, die-roller, and cold extrusion machines
- [Pelletization & Spheronization Systems](https://www.umangengineering.com/products/pelletization-and-spheronization-systems): Spheronizers and integrated extruder-spheronizer lines
- [Granulation Systems](https://www.umangengineering.com/products/granulation-systems): Rapid mixer granulators, roller compactors, granulation lines
- [Drying & Processing Equipment](https://www.umangengineering.com/products/drying-and-processing-equipment): Fluid bed dryers/processors, powder rotor processors
- [Continuous Manufacturing Systems](https://www.umangengineering.com/products/continuous-manufacturing-systems): Integrated continuous process lines
- [Film Processing](https://www.umangengineering.com/products/film-processing): Film casting machines for oral thin films
- [Spare Parts](https://www.umangengineering.com/products/spare-parts): Extrudes, screws, cones, wheels, radial meshes, and other accessories
- [Solutions](https://www.umangengineering.com/solutions): Pelletization, granulation, oral thin film, and extrusion solutions from lab trials to commercial production
- [Customize](https://www.umangengineering.com/customize): Equipment customization options

## Product Detail Pages

- [Single Screw Extruder](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/single-screw-extruder): Continuous wet-granulation extruder for extrudes/noodles, up to 300 kg/hr
- [Twin Screw Extruder](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/twin-screw-extruder): Twin-screw continuous extrusion system
- [Hot Melt Extruder](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/hot-melt-extruder): Extrusion for hot-melt formulations
- [Basket Extruder](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/basket-extruder): Basket-type extrusion system
- [Die-Roller Extruder](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/die-roller-extruder): Die-roller extrusion system
- [Cold Extrusion Machine](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/cold-extrusion-machine): Cold extrusion equipment
- [Extruder Attachments](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/extruder-attachments): Attachments/accessories for extruders
- [Spheronizer / Twin Spheronizer](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/spheronizer-or-twin-spheronizer): Spheronization equipment for pellet rounding
- [Auto Coater](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/auto-coater): Automated coating system
- [Solid Drug Layering](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/solid-drug-layering): Drug-layering process equipment
- [Powder Rotor Processor](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/powder-rotor-processor): Powder rotor processing equipment
- [Rapid Mixer Granulator](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/rapid-mixer-granulator): High-speed mixer-granulator
- [Roller Compactor](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/roller-compactor): Dry granulation via roller compaction
- [Fluid Bed Processor / Multi-Processor](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/fluid-bed-processor-or-fluid-bed-multi-processor): Fluid bed processing system
- [Fluid Bed Dryer](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/fluid-bed-dryer): Fluid bed drying equipment
- [Tapered Discharge / Auto Discharge](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/tapered-discharge-or-auto-discharge): Discharge system attachment
- [Integrated Extruder & Spheronizer (Continuous Process)](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/integrated-extruder-and-spheronizer-continues-process): Combined extrusion-spheronization continuous line
- [Granulation Line](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/granulation-line): Full granulation production line
- [Pelletization Line](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/pelletization-line): Full pelletization production line
- [Water-Dispersible Granules Continuous Production Line](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/water-dispersible-granules-continues-production-line): Continuous line for water-dispersible granules
- [Film Casting Machine](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/film-casting-machine): Machine for oral thin film casting
- [Spare Parts (Detail)](https://www.umangengineering.com/product-single/spare-parts): Detail page for spare parts and accessories
